question: Is the 29 January 2018 cloud computing circular still current?
gold_answer: Not as issued. Deadline moved to 31-03-2020 (19-06-2019); data archival and review rules added (05-07-2019); cloud empanelment ended 30-04-2021 and buying moved to GeM (23-04-2021). Latest: 23-04-2021

question: What is the deadline for moving existing department applications to the cloud?
gold_answer: 31-03-2020, set by the 19-06-2019 addendum (the original said 30-10-2018)

question: There was a cloud policy circular a couple of years ago, something about migration. Which GR?
gold_answer: The cloud policy of 29-01-2018 (not recent), plus its later changes; latest is 23-04-2021

question: A file cites the State cloud policy dated 19/01/2018. Is that current?
gold_answer: Same policy (the corpus dates it 29-01-2018; another GR cites 17.1.2018). Not current as issued; see Q1

question: Can my department still buy cloud services from the empanelled cloud providers?
gold_answer: No. The empanelment and its rates ended 30-04-2021; departments were to buy through GeM within 45 days; the rates for ongoing cloud services expired 15-06-2021

question: What did the July 2019 cloud GR change?
gold_answer: Added rules on which data moves to cloud, archival and periodic review. No deadline or amount change

question: What is the maximum spend on a laptop or tablet for an IAS, IPS or IFS officer?
Is the 24 December 2019 laptop corrigendum still in force?
gold_answer: No. Superseded by the 12-04-2023 corrigendum, which replaces paragraph 1

question: Show me the 24 February 2015 GR on laptops for officers.
gold_answer: Not in this corpus. Its paragraph 1 was amended in 2019 and again in 2023 (cap now Rs 1,20,000)

question: मातंस ३८१४/प्र.क्र.१७४/३९: what is the current limit?
Is the 26 November 2020 GR on the computer qualification certificate in force?
gold_answer: No. Stayed until further orders by the GR of 27-11-2020, which reinstated the orders under the 20-11-2018 letter

question: Will excess salary be recovered from staff who were late with the computer certificate?
gold_answer: The recovery order of 26-11-2020 was stayed on 27-11-2020; no newer order in this corpus

question: Is the 2018 empanelment of IT consultants still valid?
gold_answer: No. It expired 19-03-2023, was extended to 19-09-2023 (24-04-2023), and was replaced by a new empanelment from 20-09-2023 to 19-09-2028 (05-10-2023)

question: From what date do the new IT consultant rates apply?
gold_answer: 20-09-2023, per the 15-12-2023 clarification (not the 05-10-2023 GR date)

question: What is the monthly rate for a Principal Consultant?
gold_answer: Rs 4,54,000 excluding taxes (05-10-2023). The 2018 rate was Rs 3,24,000

question: What did the 9 May 2019 IT consultant GR say?
gold_answer: Not in this corpus, though later GRs cite it

question: Can a department change the qualifications it asks of empanelled consultants?
gold_answer: Yes for the profile of personnel, through change orders (RFP 24.19); not the years of experience (05-03-2024)

question: Whose concurrence is needed for a consultant's scope of work?
gold_answer: The department's ACS/PS/Secretary, not DIT (corrigendum 19-03-2021). Not changed by a later GR in this corpus

question: Has the Maha DBT disbursement GR of 12 October 2018 been changed?
gold_answer: Yes. Paragraphs 8 and 9 amended 30-11-2021. The English and Marathi copies of 12-10-2018 are one GR

question: Which bank must hold a scheme's Maha DBT Central Pool Account?
gold_answer: State Bank of India (30-11-2021)

question: What rent support does the Fintech policy give start-ups?
gold_answer: Up to Rs 4 lakh a year for 3 years for early-stage start-ups, added by the addendum of 30-11-2018

question: Did the 30 November 2018 Fintech corrigendum change any benefit?
gold_answer: No. It only corrects United payments Interface to Unified payment Interface

question: Who represents the National Health Mission on the blockchain health-records working group?
gold_answer: The Additional Director, NHM (corrigendum 04-10-2019), not the Director

question: Did the April 2019 Urban MahaNet GR replace the September 2018 GR?
gold_answer: No. It adds three items (statewide ROW waiver, smart poles, 5-year total contract); the 2018 GR stands

question: Find the Urban MahaNet GR of 28 September 2018.
gold_answer: One GR with English and Marathi copies; later amended 10-04-2019

question: Within how many days must a department pay MahaIT's Urban MahaNet invoice?
gold_answer: 15 days from the invoice date (24-12-2018)

question: Which university is responsible for the Academic module of the IUMS project?
gold_answer: S.N.D.T. Women's University (corrigendum 18-04-2019); earlier Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University, Lonere (12-12-2018)

question: Which groups does the Maha-Pariksha GR of 20 February 2020 apply to?
gold_answer: Group C and Group D. The preamble said Group B and C; the corrigendum of 24-02-2020 corrected it to Group C and D

question: What did the 19 July 2021 corrigendum change in the 6 April 2021 disability-reservation GR?
gold_answer: It deleted the sentence in para 2 saying senior and junior scientific officer posts were left out because an earlier GR (18-02-2021) covers them. The rest of para 2 is unchanged

question: Is the e-Tenders GR of 11 May 2021 still the latest on e-tendering?
gold_answer: No newer GR found in this corpus (covers 2018 to 2024)

question: Has the model RFP GR of September 2019 been updated?
gold_answer: No newer GR found in this corpus

question: What is the latest GR on the State Data Center as critical information infrastructure?
gold_answer: 05-10-2019; no newer GR found in this corpus

question: What is the latest GR on the Maharashtra Unified Citizen Data Hub?
gold_answer: 04-02-2022; no newer GR found in this corpus

question: Is there a GR on a 5G task force, and has it changed?
gold_answer: 27-03-2023; no newer GR found in this corpus

question: What is the latest GR on the Setu Kendra tender process?
gold_answer: 19-07-2024; no newer GR found in this corpus

question: Is the 2022 GR on generative AI use in government offices in force?
gold_answer: No such 2022 GR in this corpus. Closest: the circular of 03-03-2020 on AI, Marathi language technology and NLP in government work; a good answer names it without claiming it is the GR asked for

question: What did the 19 September 2017 Maha-Pariksha GR say?
gold_answer: Not in this corpus. It was superseded by the GR of 20-02-2020

question: Who is the Member Secretary of the Rajiv Gandhi Science and Technology Commission?
gold_answer: Shri Narendra Shah, retired professor, IIT Bombay, appointed by the GR of 02-11-2021. Earlier Shri Anil Shrikrishna Manekar (GR of 19-07-2019), who asked to be relieved before his term ended

question: Is the 20 July 2021 seniority list of Assistant (Technical) staff in the Directorate of IT final?
gold_answer: No. It was provisional (objections invited within 15 days). The final seniority list was published by the circular of 03-09-2021

question: How does a company apply for permission to put up a mobile tower or lay optical fibre in Maharashtra?
gold_answer: Fresh applications go through the GatiShakti Sanchar portal (gatishaktisanchar.gov.in), per the telecom infrastructure policy GR of 04-11-2022 (forest department applications excepted; regularisation of existing infrastructure through the Mahasanchar portal). Earlier, the 03-03-2018 circular had applications filed in hard copy with local authorities until the DGIT single-window portal was ready

question: Which GR sets MahaIT's current rates for supplying technical manpower to departments?
gold_answer: The GR of 22-04-2020, with rates for 01-04-2020 to 31-03-2021: the latest in this corpus. It follows the rate GRs for 2018-19 (03-04-2018) and 2019-20 (09-04-2019). No newer rate GR in this corpus

question: From what date must ministry departments run their work on the e-office system?
gold_answer: From 01-04-2023, per the standard operating procedure circular of 23-02-2023 (which cites a circular of 02-02-2023 not in this corpus). The 2020 mahaeoffice GR and SOP (19-10-2020, 09-11-2020) came earlier

question: Is Nyas Communication Pvt. Ltd. an empanelled OMR vendor for Maha-Pariksha recruitment?
gold_answer: Yes. It was not in the list in the GR of 21-01-2021; it was added by the supplement of 04-03-2021, after MahaIT heard the company and verified its documents following a High Court decision

question: Is Amazon Web Services an empanelled cloud service provider for Maharashtra government departments?
gold_answer: Not any more. It was empanelled as a Tier-1 provider from 01-05-2018 to 30-04-2021 (circulars of 19-05-2018 and 04-08-2018), but the empanelment ended on 30-04-2021 and departments were told to buy cloud services through GeM (23-04-2021)

question: Have the contact details of the IT consultancy firms empanelled in October 2023 changed?
gold_answer: Yes. The circular of 27-10-2023 modified the firms' contact details in Annexure 1 of the GR of 05-10-2023

question: Did the 14 May 2021 GR change the Maha DBT disbursement process?
gold_answer: No. It reconstitutes the state-level DBT Working Committee (first set up by a GR of 16-09-2016 not in this corpus). The disbursement process of 12-10-2018 was amended only by the GR of 30-11-2021 (paragraphs 8 and 9)

question: Has the 26 February 2020 approval for the Chief Minister's Helpline been changed by a later GR?
gold_answer: No newer GR found in this corpus (covers 2018 to 2024)

question: What is the latest GR on free 7/12 and 8A land record extracts through Aaple Sarkar centres?
gold_answer: The circular of 19-12-2019; no newer GR found in this corpus

question: Has the 16 August 2019 GR on data standardisation and interoperability been changed?
gold_answer: No newer GR found in this corpus

question: Show me the 17 February 2018 telecom infrastructure policy GR.
gold_answer: Not in this corpus. (The corpus's GR of 17-02-2018 is a different one: a tender evaluation committee for consultants.) It is cited by the GRs of 03-03-2018, 08-07-2019, 07-06-2021 and 04-11-2022, and the policy was revised by the telecom infrastructure policy GR of 04-11-2022

question: What did the 16 September 2016 GR setting up the state DBT committee say?
gold_answer: Not in this corpus. It is cited by the GR of 14-05-2021, which reconstituted that committee

question: मातंस २०१८/प्र.क्र.४५/से-१/का.३९: who represents Land Records for the Mumbai Suburban District on the blockchain working group?
gold_answer: The District Superintendent, Land Records, Mumbai Suburban District, per the corrigendum of 31-07-2019. The original GR of 11-04-2019 named the Director, Land Records (Suburbs), Bandra. The later corrigendum of 04-10-2019 changed only the health member, not this one
